Name: Simeon Niger
Summary: Simeon called Niger was among the prophets and teachers at Antioch who sent Barnabas and Saul to the Gentiles. His Latin nickname, meaning black, suggests he was of African origin, and he is distinct from Simeon of Jerusalem and from Simon Peter.
KeyStory: Simeon Niger worshipped at Antioch when the Spirit separated Barnabas and Saul for the Gentile mission.
RelatedPeople: Barnabas; Paul; Lucius of Cyrene; Manaen
LifeLesson: The church that sent the first missionaries already spanned continents. Simeon Niger stood in that company.
